message: The engine's automatic routes are what an AI runtime scans to map a plain request onto an engine workflow, so the surface must stay compact and legible and must reach both runtimes. This check projects every model-reachable route as (name, description, path) and goes red when any route's description runs past 120 characters, when the whole projection exceeds a 6000-character budget, or when a route reachable on Claude has no model-startable Codex twin. To fix: tighten the route descriptions, or regenerate the Codex renders so both runtimes carry the route.
